# adds_gpo_link (Resource)

Manages a **single** GPO link on an OU, domain or site, leaving every other link in place.

This resource is **non-authoritative**: unlike `adds_gpo_links` (which owns the whole ordered list), it only inserts, updates or removes the one link it declares, so several independent Terraform configurations can each link a GPO to the same target. Use it, not `adds_gpo_links`, on a target whose links are contributed by more than one state — and do not point both at the same target, or the authoritative one will prune this link.

Precedence is 1-based, matching GPMC link order (`order = 1` is highest). By default order is **not** monitored: `order` only chooses where a new link is inserted, after which links added by others never cause drift. Set `monitor_order = true` to pin this link to `order` and reconcile it back if it moves.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "adds_organizational_unit" "servers" {
  path = "Contoso/Servers"
}

# A single, non-authoritative link. Other GPOs linked to the same OU - including ones linked
# by a different Terraform configuration - are left untouched.
resource "adds_gpo_link" "baseline" {
  target = adds_organizational_unit.servers.distinguished_name
  gpo    = "Server Baseline"

  # Insert at the top on create. With monitor_order = false (the default) the link keeps its
  # slot afterwards, so links added later by other configurations never cause drift.
  order = 1
}

# A system-specific link contributed by, for example, a per-system module. It appends itself
# below whatever is already linked without disturbing the baseline above.
resource "adds_gpo_link" "system_specific" {
  target   = adds_organizational_unit.servers.distinguished_name
  gpo      = "App Server Settings"
  enforced = true
}

# Pin a link to a fixed slot and keep it there, reconciling it back if anything moves it.
# This can produce a permanent diff if another manager fights it for the slot.
resource "adds_gpo_link" "always_first" {
  target        = adds_organizational_unit.servers.distinguished_name
  gpo           = "Security Mandatory"
  order         = 1
  monitor_order = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gpo` (String) GPO to link, by GUID or display name. A GPO can be linked to a target at most once.
- `target` (String) OU, domain or site to link the GPO on. Accepts a slash-delimited path relative to the domain root (for example `Servers` or `Contoso/Servers`), a relative distinguished name such as `CN=Sites,CN=Configuration`, or a full distinguished name.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the link is enabled.
- `enforced` (Boolean) Whether the link is enforced, so it cannot be blocked or overridden at a lower level.
- `monitor_order` (Boolean) Whether to keep the link pinned at `order`. When `false` (default), position is set once on create and then left alone, so links other configurations add never cause drift. When `true`, the link is reconciled back to `order` on every apply — which can produce a permanent diff if another manager keeps moving it.
- `order` (Number) Desired 1-based precedence slot (`1` = highest, applied first). Omit to append the link at the bottom (lowest precedence). With `monitor_order = false` (the default) this only positions the link when it is first created; afterwards the link keeps its slot and is never moved. With `monitor_order = true` the link is kept at this slot and moved back if it drifts. Required when `monitor_order = true`.

### Read-Only

- `current_order` (Number) The link's actual 1-based precedence position as read from Active Directory, which reflects links contributed by other configurations.
- `gpo_guid` (String) Resolved GUID of `gpo`.
- `gpo_name` (String) Resolved display name of `gpo`.
- `id` (String) Terraform resource identifier, `<target DN>|<GPO GUID>`.
- `target_dn` (String) Resolved distinguished name of `target`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A single GPO link is imported with a composite id: <target DN>|<GPO GUID>.
terraform import adds_gpo_link.baseline \
  "OU=Servers,OU=Contoso,DC=contoso,DC=local|11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555"
```
